blocks.text: THE HAGUE, Netherlands—Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice said on Thursday in a historic ruling. The tribunal also ordered that refugees be given safe passage home and awarded compensation. The ruling by the top UN court was the first time in its 80-year history that ICJ judges have determined that a state committed genocide.
